question: If Aeromunculus somehow loses all of its +1/+1 counters, can I adapt it again to get more counters?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: with no +1/+1 counters it can adapt again and get more.
expected.answer: If a creature somehow loses all of its +1/+1 counters, it can adapt again and get more +1/+1 counters.
